premise.text: Vintner at Gymnasium, facing Seeing corruption / discrimination, with a Responsible instinct and a Pretentious streak in a Rush mode

contestants.style: dry, compact, understated jokes with a hard final turn
surreal but readable jokes with strange concrete images
character-forward jokes with setup, escalation, and clean punchline
language-driven jokes, reversals, and neat phrase twists
light roast energy aimed at objects and situations, not people

jokes.label: Joke A
jokes.title: Oaky Whistle
jokes.setup: The responsible vintner came to the gymnasium to audit the fundraiser and found the scoreboard quietly giving extra points to whoever donated a barrel.
jokes.punchline: He reported the corruption, then asked if the whistle came in something with more oaky restraint.

jokes.label: Joke B
jokes.title: Rush Offense
jokes.setup: In the gymnasium, the vintner watched the fast break go so badly that the basketballs began aging themselves in oak barrels under the bleachers.
jokes.punchline: By halftime, the coach had decanted the rush offense into a smaller, more pretentious offense.

jokes.label: Joke C
jokes.title: Substitution
jokes.setup: The coach asked the visiting vintner to sub in after three players got benched for bribing the referee with concession-stand merlot.
jokes.punchline: He said he would, but only after a responsible warmup and an irresponsible amount of sniffing the basketball.

jokes.label: Joke D
jokes.title: Foul Notes
jokes.setup: The vintner spotted corruption in the gymnasium the moment the referee called a foul before the shot and a cabernet after it.
jokes.punchline: He called it a full-bodied scandal with strong notes of foul play.

jokes.label: Joke E
jokes.title: Let It Breathe
jokes.setup: The gymnasium hired a pretentious vintner as its ethics monitor, and he immediately found the booster club bribing referees with commemorative pinot.
jokes.punchline: He blew the whistle, then swirled it first, because even accountability needs to breathe.

scores.comment: Good odd image, though the payoff is more clever than laugh-out-loud.
Readable escalation with a small final absurdity.
The pun is familiar but cleanly aimed and well timed.
Best final turn; the pretension becomes the mechanism.
Dry and coherent, with a mild but tidy finish.
Nice physical detail, but the sniffing button is a medium laugh.
Polished phrase work with a clear wine-sports blend.
The act of swirling the whistle is specific and quotable.
A responsible little joke, but the last phrase is restrained.
Great image; the punchline is amusing but diffuse.
Efficient and easy to get, with a nice clean tag.
The character behavior makes the joke, not just the word choice.
The phrase oaky restraint is pleasant, though the laugh is modest.
Memorable barrel logic, slightly soft as a punchline.
Good sitcom object work; not quite a sharp enough turn.
A strong phrase anchored in a clear visual action.
Neat, but a little too polite to leave a bruise.
Creative image, but the laugh has to find its own parking.
The basketball sniff is silly, but not the cleanest hit.
Solid pun construction, even if the wine-crime lane is familiar.

comicPanelPrompt: Single-panel gothic newspaper comic for Paperclipalypse. Scene: a pretentious vintner in a dim gymnasium swirls a referee whistle like a wine glass while paperclips watch from the bleachers and a corrupt scoreboard glows overhead. Style: dark ink, warm brown metal highlights, expressive faces, no speech bubbles except a tiny sign reading Paperclipalypse.
